home.heroSubtitle: Since 2012 we provide press, beverage and food product transport and distribution services
home.aboutText: The company was founded in 2012. At that time, the local transport market was just forming, courier and parcel companies were emerging. Specific customer needs provided opportunities to enter the transport business. Press delivery to shopping centers became one of those specific services we still provide today.
home.servicesSubtitle: We specialize in local transport in Kaunas County
home.service1Desc: Press distribution to shopping centers throughout Kaunas County. Reliable and timely delivery.
home.service2Desc: Beverage and food product transport and distribution (without temperature control) in Kaunas County.
home.whyText: UAB ASMI has been operating since 2012. By focusing on Kaunas County and maintaining stable, planned routes, we ensure reliable and timely delivery. Our vehicle fleet consists of cargo vans and medium-duty trucks, allowing us to flexibly meet various customer needs.
home.ctaText: Get in touch with us and we'll discuss how we can help your business.

about.title: About ASMI
about.subtitle: Reliable transport partners since 2012
about.bioP1: The company was founded in 2012. At that time, the local transport market was just forming, courier and parcel companies were emerging. Specific customer needs provided opportunities to enter the transport business.
about.bioP2: Press delivery to shopping centers became one of those specific services we still provide today. Currently our vehicle fleet consists of cargo vans and medium-duty trucks.
about.bioP3: We provide services in Kaunas County. Focusing on a selected geographical zone and route optimization gives us competitive advantages in the dynamic transport business.
about.fleetDesc: Cargo vans and medium-duty trucks, allowing us to flexibly meet various customer needs.
about.adv1Desc: We have stable, planned routes in Kaunas County, ensuring reliable and timely delivery.
about.adv2Desc: By focusing on one geographical zone, we can quickly respond to changes in customer needs.
about.adv3Desc: Over ten years of experience in the transport business gives us the knowledge and ability to work efficiently.
